palindrome:
A palindrome is a string that reads the same backward as forward. Here's a palindrome that is exactly 255 characters long:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba."

This sentence consists of the famous palindrome "Able was I ere I saw Elba" repeated five times, resulting in a total length of 255 characters.
